scope: evaluation-only reusable admission gate for future exact-host extraction rules using only the certified Phase 4F primitives; Phase 4G itself admits no production site-specific rule

problem_statement.certified_capability: Phase 4F provides an empty-by-default exact-host rule engine supporting only remove_selectors and force_browser
problem_statement.repository_evidence: there are no open repository issues or frozen real-domain failure bundles that justify enabling a production site-specific rule
problem_statement.risk: adding host entries directly to production configuration without frozen before/after evidence could hide regressions, overfit transient markup, or bypass the project's evidence-first rule
problem_statement.phase4g_response: define and certify a deterministic evidence format and evaluator that can admit or reject future rule candidates without changing production extraction behavior

admission_bundle_contract.host_semantics: the candidate host must satisfy the certified Phase 4F exact normalized DNS-host validation; wildcard, suffix, IP-literal, scheme, port, path and credential forms are invalid
admission_bundle_contract.frozen_input_rule: all fixture HTML, marker sets, candidate rule values and source metadata are committed before the evaluator scores that bundle
admission_bundle_contract.hashing: the report must freeze SHA-256 hashes for every static and rendered HTML input and for the canonicalized bundle definition

scoring_contract.baseline: run the certified Readability/Turndown extraction semantics with no site-specific rule
scoring_contract.candidate: run the same extraction semantics with exactly the bundle's candidate rule and no other site rule
scoring_contract.required_markers: 100% of preregistered required markers must survive candidate extraction
scoring_contract.forbidden_markers: 0 preregistered forbidden markers may survive candidate extraction
scoring_contract.demonstrated_need: the no-rule baseline must fail at least one preregistered marker condition; a bundle whose baseline already passes is rejected as no demonstrated need
scoring_contract.strict_improvement: the candidate must convert the target bundle from fail to pass under the same marker contract
scoring_contract.rendered_requirement: a force_browser candidate requires a frozen rendered_html input and must demonstrate that the rendered candidate passes where the static baseline fails
scoring_contract.remove_selector_requirement: a remove_selectors candidate must demonstrate that configured removal causes the passing candidate result; a missing-match no-op cannot justify admission
scoring_contract.invalid_selector_behavior: invalid selector state must remain baseline-equivalent rather than produce a passing admission result
scoring_contract.combined_rule: a rule using both primitives is admissible only if the bundle demonstrates that the combined behavior is required; if either strict subset also passes, the smaller rule must be selected
scoring_contract.determinism: repeated evaluation of the same frozen bundle must produce byte-identical extracted output and identical admission decision

control_contract.clean_control_behavior: when the candidate host rule does not apply, output must remain byte-for-byte identical to the certified no-rule baseline
control_contract.host_isolation: the candidate rule must not apply to a parent domain, sibling domain or subdomain unless that exact normalized host is the candidate host
control_contract.canonical_isolation: rel=canonical content never changes rule admission or host matching
fail_open_controls: invalid remove selector leaves extraction baseline-equivalent
missing remove-selector match leaves extraction baseline-equivalent
force_browser with browser capability unavailable retains static baseline behavior
render failure retains static baseline behavior

decision_contract.admit: admit a future production host rule only when demonstrated_need, strict_improvement, all marker checks, minimality, determinism, host isolation and all applicable fail-open controls pass
decision_contract.reject: reject on any failed prerequisite and freeze the explicit rejection reasons
decision_contract.no_evidence_outcome: when no real-domain failure bundle has been preregistered, the admitted production rule set remains empty

evaluator_self_test_contract.purpose: prove the reusable admission protocol itself before it is trusted on future real-domain bundles
evaluator_self_test_contract.reuse: Phase 4E fixture material may be reused for protocol self-tests, but self-test fixtures are not evidence for a production site-specific rule
